tara (design): Quick thread 1: proposal to compress the latency toolbar into one line so heatmaps get more vertical room. Presets: 10s / 30s / 5m / 30m. Custom opens a panel. Sampling as collapsed chip that expands to a tiny slider. Mock: figma.com/s/compact-latency kevin (frontend): Agree on one line. Two implementation notes: 1) sampling chip needs a changed indicator (dot or short %), 2) expand as absolute overlay to avoid layout shift. yara (eng): Backend note: sampling changes aggregation path. Please send sampling_pct in the URL and debounce slider updates (200ms). We'll expose a lightweight p95 endpoint so the UI can fetch it separately. mike (pm): Product note: default sampling 25% for most orgs. Make presets keyboard reachable and add telemetry for preset_click vs custom_open. Keep p95 pinned and tappable to open distribution. olga (a11y): Accessibility checklist highlights: presets must be focusable and announced (role=listbox or tablist), sampling pill must expose aria-expanded + aria-controls, slider needs aria-valuetext like "Sampling: 25%", and chart updates should be announced via aria-live polite ("Latency chart updated to 1 minute range"). Also increase contrast of tiny legend chips on dark theme. tara (design): Proposed microcopy for tooltip: "Sampling reduces processing and storage; may hide short spikes." Short and concrete. Also propose a low-density overlay for <=5%: badge "low sampling expect noise" + subtle hatch pattern for colorblind users. kevin (frontend): Implementation sketch:
[10s][30s][5m][30m]
p95: 130ms
. Slider uses aria-valuetext and we debounce network calls. yara (eng): Confirmed: add `?sampling_pct=25` to route and fire `latency_sampling_change` and `timebar_preset_click` telemetry. Server will cache p95 for 1s and compute on range change. mike (pm): Decision: ship v1 with compact toolbar, custom panel, collapsed sampling pill (default 25%), pinned p95, and telemetry hooks. Follow-ups: olga to deliver full a11y checklist; kevin to prototype UI; yara to add query param + telemetry; tara to update mocks and contrast tokens. olga (a11y): I'll post checklist by tomorrow: focus order, listbox semantics, aria-live phrasing, keyboard flow for custom panel, slider aria examples, tooltip dismissible via Escape, and contrast targets. telemetry-bot: Event recorded: `timebar_preset_click` by tara at 1991234610 kevin (frontend): I'll prototype the chip + overlay and low-density badge by Friday. Will include keyboard interactions and a dot indicator for non-default sampling. tara (design): Thanks team 1: I'll bring copy + contrast spec to UX sync and ship mocks with the low-density pattern option. :white_check_mark:
